Titles.eng: I Made Friends With the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
Titles.jpn: クラスで2番目に可愛い女の子と友だちになった

Summaries.eng: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right—until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the “second prettiest in class” by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend!
Summaries.jpn:
クラスでぼっちな前原真樹に、初めてできた友だち・朝凪海。
いつも輪の中心にいて、他の男子からは
『クラスで2番目に可愛い』なんて陰で噂されている。
ぼっちの自分なんかとは住む世界が違う━━と思いきや、、、
